in_sanskrit.name: Sharvikarth
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है God of Victory
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Sharvikarth एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Sharvikarth is a compound name derived from 'Sharva' (god of happiness) and 'Karth' (god of war). The name evokes the image of a victorious and courageous god.

in_hindi.name: शर्विकढ
in_hindi.long_meaning: The one who has Sharva (a form of Shiva) as a protector and victorious over challenges (vikatha)

in_tamil.name: Sharvikarth
in_tamil.meaning: இந்து பெயர் என்று பொருள் God of Victory
in_tamil.long_meaning: Sharvikarth ஒரு இந்து பெயர் ஆகும், இது இந்திய கலாச்சாரத்தில் ஆழமான ஆன்மீக முக்கியத்துவத்தைக் கொண்டுள்ளது। Sharvikarth is a compound name derived from 'Sharva' (god of happiness) and 'Karth' (god of war). The name evokes the image of a victorious and courageous god.

in_telugu.name: Sharvikarth
in_telugu.meaning: హిందూ పేరు అంటే God of Victory
in_telugu.long_meaning: Sharvikarth ఒక హిందూ పేరు, ఇది భారతీయ సంస్కృతిలో లోతైన ఆధ్యాత్మిక ప్రాముఖ్యతను కలిగి ఉంది। Sharvikarth is a compound name derived from 'Sharva' (god of happiness) and 'Karth' (god of war). The name evokes the image of a victorious and courageous god.

in_marathi.name: Sharvikarth
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of Victory
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sharvikarth हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Sharvikarth is a compound name derived from 'Sharva' (god of happiness) and 'Karth' (god of war). The name evokes the image of a victorious and courageous god.
